title: Spell Sigils
summary: Animated magic circles for Pathfinder Second Edition spells, each derived from the spell's rank, traditions, traits and category.
tagline: An animated magic circle for every Pathfinder spell.
description: Pick any of more than 2,000 Pathfinder Second Edition spells, focus spells and rituals and watch its magic circle draw itself. Rank, traditions, traits and category decide the sigil's bands, geometry, colours and glyphs, and a random stream seeded on the spell's identity fills in the rest, so a spell always produces the same sigil.

features.title: Drawn from the rules
features.description: Rank sets the rune bands and the sides of the central polygon, traditions set the colours and the runes, and traits appear as glyphs in medallions round the ring.

features.title: The same sigil every time
features.description: Each sigil comes from a random stream seeded on the spell's identity, so a spell draws the same circle on every visit and every device.

features.title: Ritual caster stations
features.description: A ritual is ringed by caster stations, the primary caster at the bottom, each marked with the sigil of a skill its checks accept and ruled to show the proficiency needed.

features.title: Focus spells
features.description: Focus spells take their class's colour and are written as spaced script with no ruled lines, as personal magic rather than drilled tradition magic.

features.title: Search and filter
features.description: Search by name, filter by tradition, rank, ritual or focus spell, and narrow focus spells by class.

features.title: Parchment mode
features.description: Shows the sigil as ink on paper, with trait glyphs and skill sigils picked out in red as in a manuscript.

features.title: Max glow
features.description: Holds the sigil at the peak of the glow it flashes once when it finishes drawing.

features.title: Copy and save
features.description: Copy the sigil to the clipboard or save it as a PNG, in either look.

features.title: A link for every spell
features.description: The address names the spell on show, so a link opens the same sigil.

features.title: Symbol atlas
features.description: A separate page shows every rune, trait glyph and skill sigil the sigils are drawn from.

features.title: Phones and tablets
features.description: The layout adapts to the screen, with the spell list in a drawer on a phone.
